texts.zh:
方舟飞船[Root.GetName]正在经历反应堆异常。最初注意到这个问题的是即将入睡的船员，因为引擎声伴着他们入眠。他们报告说是燃料流节奏出现了细微的失真。
我方[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]的调查证实，燃料管道内有异物进入。

幸运的是，我们已提出了几个解决方案。
texts.en:
Arkship [Root.GetName] is experiencing reactor irregularities. The issue was first noticed by crew who listen to the engines to fall asleep. They reported a subtle distortion in the fuel flow's rhythm.
 
Investigation by our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] has confirmed that foreign matter has entered the fuel piping.

Thankfully, several solutions have already been proposed.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]号方舟舰的反应堆出现了异常。这个问题最初是由其指定休息区靠近引擎的[Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural]发现的。他们报告燃料流动的节律发生了细微的扭曲。
我方[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]的调查证实，燃料管道内有异物进入。

幸运的是，我们已提出了几个解决方案。
texts.en:
Arkship [Root.GetName] is experiencing reactor irregularities. The issue was first noticed by [Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural] who's designated rest area is near the engine. They reported a subtle distortion in the fuel flow's rhythm. 
Investigation by our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] has confirmed that foreign matter has entered the fuel piping.

Thankfully, several solutions have already been proposed.

label.en: Good thing we have a spare.

label.zh: 我们将继续前进，群星不等人。
label.en: We will carry on, the stars can not wait.

label.zh: 让引擎以较低频率运行。
label.en: Run the engines on a slower frequency.
